seo.title: Seedream 5.5 | Precise image edits and transparent PNGs | MaxVideoAI
seo.description: Create and edit images with Seedream 5.5 by ByteDance in MaxVideoAI. Use up to 10 references, 1K–2K output and native transparent PNGs.

overview: Seedream 5.5 creates still images and edits from up to 10 references. Use it for product visuals, repeated image edits and transparent PNG assets, with one result per request in 1K, 1.5K or 2K.
pricingNotes: The exact current price is shown before you confirm generation. Resolution and reference images can change the quote.

tips.title: Generation and editing tips
items: Describe the subject, composition, materials, lighting and exact text. For edits, separate the parts to preserve from the changes.
Give every reference a clear role: subject, product, style or background.
Choose PNG and a transparent background for an image with an alpha channel.
Review rendered text and fine details before publishing.

prompts.title: Product composition
prompts.prompt: A premium amber glass bottle on pale stone, soft side light, clean studio background, realistic glass reflections, centered composition with space for a headline.

prompts.title: Reference edit
prompts.prompt: Using the reference, keep the person’s identity, face, hairstyle and clothing. Replace only the background with a bright modern studio and preserve the camera angle.

prompts.title: Text layout
prompts.prompt: Editorial product poster with a clear grid and generous margins. Exact headline "NEW PERSPECTIVE" at the top, small subheading "AUTUMN COLLECTION", clean readable lettering.

faqs.a: The direct MaxVideoAI integration offers 1K, 1.5K and 2K.

faqs.q: Can I edit several reference images?
faqs.a: Yes. Image-to-image accepts up to 10 references and returns one generated image.

faqs.q: Can one request create a batch of images?
faqs.a: No. This model returns one image per request. Seedream 5.0 Lite remains available for image sets.

faqs.q: How do I check the price?
faqs.a: Select the model, resolution and references. MaxVideoAI shows the current quote before confirmation.
